definitions.explanation: The gradual change or development of something over time.

examples.japanese: {株価|かぶか}の{推移|すいい}を{見守|みまも}る。
examples.english: To watch the trend of stock prices.

examples.japanese: {人口|じんこう}の{推移|すいい}を{分析|ぶんせき}する。
{今後|こんご}の{推移|すいい}を{注視|ちゅうし}する。

notes:
{推移|すいい} refers to gradual change or development over time. It emphasizes the process of transition rather than sudden change.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {推移|すいい}を{見守|みまも}る: to watch trends
- {推移|すいい}を{追|お}う: to follow developments
- {推移|すいい}グラフ: trend graph
- {推移|すいい}する: to transition, change over time

TYPICAL CONTEXTS:
- {人口|じんこう}の{推移|すいい}: population trends
- {物価|ぶっか}の{推移|すいい}: price trends
- {時代|じだい}の{推移|すいい}: passage of time, changing of eras

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {変化|へんか}: change (general, can be sudden or gradual)
- {推移|すいい}: transition (gradual, over time, data-oriented)
- {動向|どうこう}: trends, movements (broader scope, future-looking)

REGISTER:
Formal; frequently seen in news articles, reports, and academic writing.
